title: 第9章 死胖子第10章 谁不知死活
content_zh:
不得不说‘十里秦淮’的夜景非常震撼，东水关遗址、秦淮水亭、桃叶渡、白鹭洲、江南贡院、瞻园、中华门瓮城、乌衣巷等等，乘坐古色古香的画舫，欣赏沿岸古建筑群，宛如一幅流动的历史长卷，令游客仿佛穿越了时空的隧道，回到那个繁华的古代金陵。
回到夫子庙游船码头，看着那人头攒动的排队游客，众人禁不住暗暗咋舌，还好晚餐吃的比较快，要是再晚半个小时，想要乘画舫夜游秦淮河，排队一个小时也不见得上的了画舫。
回到岸上后，众人失去夜游夫子庙的兴趣，市民在家里憋了近半年，疫情好不容易全面解禁，鬼知道有多少万市民要来秦淮河游玩，夫子庙那肯定早已堵的水泄不通。
大餐已蹭了，秦淮河也玩了，下一个项目去KTV唱歌喝酒，人家小圈子自己玩，江凡跟着去凑热闹，那不是没一点眼力劲，何况他压根不会唱什么歌，也不想浪费宝贵的修炼时间。
开什么玩笑，李子茜狠狠瞪了眼江凡，能不能别这么扫兴，大家也没有把你当外人，好不容易可以出来放风，夜生活刚刚开始，生日宴会下半场还没开始，你一个大老爷们就要闪人，着急回学校睡觉？
帝豪KTV，秦淮区最大的KTV，也是金陵最豪华KTV之一，音响设备全部进口国外顶级品牌，其装修设计由国外知名设计师倾力打造，富二代和商务人士首选之地。
江凡也只是听宿舍的金陵哥们吹嘘过，帝豪KTV的小包厢抵消起价800元，豪华包厢点几瓶进口红酒可能达到五位数，不少公主是一些艺校的系花和校花云云……
没过多久，一行八人来到帝豪KTV门前，三层的欧式建筑，绚丽的霓虹灯散发着诱人的光芒，金碧辉煌装修更是亮瞎双眼，只是一些染着五颜六色头发的非主流杀马特有点大煞风景。
帝豪KTV成为金陵最豪华KTV之一不是没有原因，门口迎宾两位服务员颜值秒杀一众美女，服务台收银员堪比港台一线女明星，扫了眼包厢价目表，妥妥的销金窟。
进入提前预订好的二楼包厢，李子茜扫了眼东张西望的江凡，随即打趣道：“你是没来过KTV，还是没来过上档次的KTV？”
“唱歌五音不全，一共也就去过三四次KTV，基本是同学聚会才去的KTV。”
“不会吧，紫菱可是人大附中的超级麦霸，你居然唱歌五音不全？”
李子茜震惊看向江凡，紫菱的唱功不弱于港台二流歌星，一母同胞的江凡竟然唱歌五音不全，难道歌唱天赋全被紫菱继承了？
“这有什么奇怪的，全国高考看江苏，江苏高考看苏州，医院有学习区，学生一边学习一边打针，左手被针扎的全青了，也坚决不能打右手，你觉得我有时间听什么歌曲吗？”
江苏那是真的既拼爹又拼娃，不能让孩子输在起跑线上，其他省的孩子一年级开始卷，而江苏的孩子在两岁学前班就要各种卷，各科成绩要是低于90分，回家可能被打断腿。
江苏卷的最根本原因，绝大部分江苏人不喜欢离开本地，更别提出国留学什么，很多学生宁愿留在江苏读个二本院校，也不会选择外省的985高校！
江苏的经济、科技、教育、医疗、工业等各行各业发达也不是没有原因，除了优越的地理条件，人才才是江苏发达的根基，学霸只读金陵大学，学渣才读清北，几乎所有的人才留在了本地，还吸引了大量外地人才，不发达那才是真正的见鬼。
广州差不多同样的道理，学生不喜欢离开粤语区域，又离不开独有的早茶、煲汤、和白切鸡，本地人才基本全部留在本地，又吸引全国各地的人才，经济发达那不很正常嘛。
“江凡，你们中药学专业是学什么的？”
张思雯好奇问道，好奇怪的专业名字，中药学不会是研究种植中药材和生产中药，可那也不用浪费四年时间去学习吧。

真没见识，不等江凡开口，张兆庆便开口解释道：“中药学主要学习中医学、中药学、毒理学、中药研制等方面知识和技能，需要非常扎实的生物、化学、物理功底，狭隘意义上可以理解为中医，，，”
闲聊几分钟，服务员端着果盘、搬着酒水陆陆续续送到包厢，再次合唱《生日快乐歌》，寿星献唱一首歌曲，五位美女开始抢麦，或是独唱，或是合唱，那是一个热闹。
江凡、牧华伟、张兆庆，三人坐在包厢角落的沙发喝酒，偶尔牧华伟和张兆庆会被女友和妹妹喊去合唱，江凡一个人倒是乐在清静。
什么狗屁人头马XO，一瓶价格顶得上普通人一个月薪水，口感比起十块的金陵春差远了，江凡果断换上百威啤酒，KTV里价格比超市贵了三倍不止，还不如坐在玄武湖公园边喝边吼。
“江大才子，酒量可以啊。”
李子茜一口抽掉瓶里啤酒，大哥，这才进包厢半个小时，你一个人干掉一箱啤酒，跟没事人似的，真是海量。
小主，这个章节后面还有哦，请点击下一页继续阅读，后面更精彩！
“没办法，酒精考验，酒量是从小练出来的。”
真的是一言难尽，前身母亲江诗雅不是在苏州开日料餐厅，每天客人会剩下不少开瓶没喝完的各类酒水，那些进口的日本清酒和啤酒很贵，可餐厅服务员和厨师不喜欢喝日本的酒水，更何况是日本客人喝剩下的。
那时餐厅服务员一天工资不到十块钱，餐厅每天剩下的酒水价值好几百，倒掉岂不是糟蹋钱，于是江母选择了糟蹋儿子，美名其曰熟悉日本酒水文化，未来好继承自家日料餐厅，把餐厅发扬光大，以后好赚日本人的钱。
其实想起来，非常温馨的母子情，母子相依为命，江诗雅一生的奋斗目标是给江凡留下令普通人无法企及的财富和产业，可惜天不遂人愿，事常逆己心！
正当李子茜要询问江凡的酒量是怎么从幼练出，只见张思雯惊慌跑进包厢，衣衫有些凌乱，显然被人撕扯过，慌张喊道：“色狼，有禽兽要非礼我！”
张兆庆见到妹妹如此惨状，脸上更是有红彤彤巴掌手印，瞬间气不打一处来，愤怒扔掉手里香烟，快步来到小妹身前，“思雯，怎么回事，谁打的你！”
“思雯，怎么回事？发生了什么事情？”
张思雯惊魂未定，结结巴巴说道：“我刚才在卫生间洗手，突然出现一个死胖子，他不仅拍我的屁股，还问我包夜……”

content_en:
I have to say that the night view of the "Ten Miles of Qinhuai" is very shocking, including the Dongshuiguan ruins, Qinhuai Water Pavilion, Taoye Ferry, Bailuzhou, Jiangnan Gongyuan, Zhanyuan, Zhonghuamen Wengcheng, Wuyi Lane, etc. Taking an antique painted boat and admiring the ancient buildings along the coast is like a long flowing historical scroll, making tourists feel as if they have traveled through a tunnel of time and space and returned to the prosperous ancient Jinling.
Returning to the Confucius Temple Cruise Ship Terminal, everyone couldn't help but secretly gasped in surprise as they looked at the crowded line of tourists. Fortunately, dinner was eaten quickly. If we had been half an hour later and wanted to take a boat ride on the Qinhuai River at night, we wouldn't have been able to get on the boat after queuing for an hour.
After returning to the shore, everyone lost interest in visiting the Confucius Temple at night. The citizens had been holding back at home for nearly half a year. The epidemic was finally fully lifted. Who knows how many thousands of citizens wanted to come to the Qinhuai River to play. The Confucius Temple must have been blocked by the water.
The feast has been finished, and Qinhuai River has also been played. The next project is to go to KTV to sing and drink, and the other people play in a small circle by themselves. Jiang Fan followed to join in the fun. It is not that he has no eyesight, not to mention that he can't sing any songs at all, and he doesn't want to waste precious training time.
Are you kidding me? Li Ziqian glared at Jiang Fan fiercely. Can you stop being such a spoiler? No one treats you like an outsider. You can finally come out to show off. The nightlife has just begun. The second half of the birthday party has not yet started. You, a grown-up man, want to get out of the way and rush back to school to sleep?
Dihao KTV is the largest KTV in Qinhuai District and one of the most luxurious KTVs in Jinling. The audio equipment is all imported from top foreign brands. Its decoration design is created by well-known foreign designers. It is the first choice for the rich second generation and business people.
Jiang Fan had only heard the Jinling buddies in the dormitory brag about it. The price of a small box in Dihao KTV starts at 800 yuan, and a few bottles of imported red wine in a luxury box can reach five figures. Many princesses are the department and school beauties of some art schools...
Not long after, a group of eight people came to the door of Dihao KTV. The three-story European-style building, the gorgeous neon lights exuded an alluring light, and the splendid decoration was blinding. However, some non-mainstream killers with colorful hair were a bit annoying.
There is a reason why Dihao KTV has become one of the most luxurious KTVs in Jinling. The two waiters greeting the guests at the door are more beautiful than any other. The cashier at the service desk is comparable to the first-line female stars in Hong Kong and Taiwan. After glancing at the price list of the private rooms, they are sure to buy it.
Entering the private room on the second floor that had been booked in advance, Li Ziqian glanced at Jiang Fan who was looking around, and then joked: "Have you never been to a KTV, or have you never been to a high-end KTV?"
"I'm tone-deaf in singing. I've only been to KTV three or four times in total. It's basically a KTV I only go to for class reunions."
"No way, Zi Ling is a super wheat tycoon at the High School Affiliated to Renmin University of China, and you're actually tone deaf when you sing?"
Li Ziqian looked at Jiang Fan in shock. Zi Ling's singing skills were not inferior to those of second-rate singers from Hong Kong and Taiwan. Jiang Fan, who was born to the same mother, was tone deaf. Could it be that Zi Ling had inherited all her singing talent?
"What's weird about this? The national college entrance examination is based on Jiangsu, and the Jiangsu college entrance examination is based on Suzhou. The hospital has a study area. Students are studying while getting injections. The left hand was completely green after being pricked by needles, and I am determined not to inject my right hand. Do you think I have time to listen to any songs?"
Jiangsu really strives for both father and child, and cannot let the children lose at the starting line. Children in other provinces start taking exams in the first grade, but children in Jiangsu need all kinds of exams at two-year-old preschool. If the score in each subject is less than 90 points, their legs may be broken when they go home.
The most fundamental reason for the Jiangsu examination is that the vast majority of Jiangsu people do not like to leave the local area, let alone study abroad. Many students would rather stay in Jiangsu and study in a second university than choose a 985 university in other provinces!
It is not without reason that Jiangsu’s economy, science and technology, education, medical care, industry and other industries are developed. In addition to superior geographical conditions, Jiangsu’s talents are the developmentThe top students only study at Jinling University, while the bad students only study at Qingbei University. Almost all the talents stay in the local area, and it also attracts a large number of talents from outside. Underdevelopment is the real hell.
The same is true in Guangzhou. Students don't like to leave the Cantonese-speaking area, and they can't do without the unique morning tea, soup, and boiled chicken. Basically all local talents stay in the local area, and it attracts talents from all over the country. Isn't it normal for the economy to be developed?
"Jiang Fan, what do you major in Chinese Materia Medica?"
Zhang Siwen asked curiously, what a strange professional name. Isn't the study of Chinese Materia Medica the study of growing Chinese medicinal materials and producing Chinese medicines? But there is no need to waste four years studying it.
He was really ignorant. Before Jiang Fan could speak, Zhang Zhaoqing started to explain: "Traditional Chinese Materia Medica mainly studies knowledge and skills in Chinese medicine, Chinese materia medica, toxicology, Chinese medicine development and other aspects. It requires a very solid foundation in biology, chemistry, and physics. In a narrow sense, it can be understood as Chinese medicine,,,"
After chatting for a few minutes, the waiters carried fruit plates and drinks to the box one after another. They sang "Happy Birthday" again. The birthday girl sang a song. The five beauties started to compete for the microphone, either solo or in chorus. It was a lively scene.
Jiang Fan, Mu Huawei, and Zhang Zhaoqing were sitting on the sofa in the corner of the box drinking. Occasionally, Mu Huawei and Zhang Zhaoqing would be called to sing a chorus by their girlfriends and sisters, but Jiang Fan was enjoying the quiet time alone.
What nonsense is Remy Martin XO? The price of a bottle is equivalent to a month's salary of an ordinary person. The taste is far worse than the ten yuan Jinlingchun. Jiang Fan decisively changed to Budweiser beer. The price in the KTV is more than three times more expensive than in the supermarket. It is better to sit in Xuanwu Lake Park and drink and yell.
"Jiang is a great talent. He can drink well."
Li Ziqian drained the beer from the bottle in one gulp, "Brother, you've only been in the box for half an hour, and you drank a box of beer by yourself, as if nothing happened. It's really a huge amount."
My dear, there is more to come after this chapter. Please click on the next page to continue reading. There will be more exciting chapters later!
"No way, it's an alcohol test. I've been practicing drinking since I was young."
It’s really hard to explain. My predecessor, my mother Jiang Shiya, didn’t open a Japanese restaurant in Suzhou. Every day, customers would leave a lot of unfinished bottles of various drinks. The imported Japanese sake and beer were very expensive, but the restaurant waiters and chefs didn’t like to drink Japanese drinks, let alone the leftovers from Japanese customers.
At that time, the restaurant waiter's salary was less than ten yuan a day, and the leftover drinks in the restaurant every day were worth several hundred. Wouldn't it be a waste of money to throw them away? So Jiang's mother chose to waste her son, claiming that he was familiar with Japanese drinking culture, so that he could inherit his own Japanese restaurant in the future, promote the restaurant, and make money from the Japanese in the future.
In fact, when I think about it, the love between mother and son is very warm, and mother and son depend on each other for life. Jiang Shiya's lifelong goal is to leave Jiang Fan with wealth and industry that ordinary people cannot reach. Unfortunately, God does not fulfill people's wishes, and things often go against one's own will!
Just when Li Ziqian was about to ask how Jiang Fan developed his drinking ability since childhood, Zhang Siwen ran into the box in panic. Her clothes were a little messy and had obviously been torn by someone. She panicked and shouted: "Pervert, there is an animal trying to molest me!"
Zhang Zhaoqing saw his sister in such a miserable state, with red palm prints on her face. He was so angry that he threw away the cigarette in his hand angrily and quickly came to the little sister, "Siwen, what's going on? Who beat you!"
"Siwen, what's going on? What happened?"
Zhang Siwen was in shock, and stammered: "I was washing my hands in the bathroom just now, and suddenly a fat man appeared. He not only slapped my butt, but also asked me to book the night..."
